verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents native dbt project support: "dbt Projects on Snowflake" covers the full dbt lifecycle (develop, deploy, orchestrate, observe) on managed dbt Core and dbt Fusion runtimes, and includes a migration guide from dbt Core. Community discussion confirms practitioners run dbt models on Snowflake, though it doesn't address the native feature specifically. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the native dbt Projects feature itself, and evidence of a documented dbt adapter (dbt-snowflake).
